notes.author: ted
notes.text: Three people in Bill's group are asking about baptism. Meeting with him next week to plan a class for them.
notes.testPurpose: A Follow-up note with a reply on a small group leader.

replies.author: pete
replies.text: Count me in to teach the first session.

notes.author: pete
notes.text: Bill offered to host the new believers lunch at his business again this spring. He covers the food every year and asks that we not announce it.
notes.testPurpose: A Personal Note on a generous giver who leads a group for people new to faith.

notes.author: pete
notes.text: Talked with Alisha after her dad's heart procedure. He is home and recovering well. She asked for prayer for the drives back and forth to Tucson this month.
notes.testPurpose: A Pastoral note with a reply on the Rock administrator.

replies.author: ted
replies.text: Praying. Let us know if meals would help while she is on the road.

notes.author: pete
notes.text: Met with Bill about the stress of growing his business. Talked through limits on work hours and protecting time at home. Meeting again in three weeks.
notes.testPurpose: A Counseling note, seen only by pastoral workers and Rock administrators.

notes.author: pete
notes.text: Alisha is the person to ask about anything in Rock: security roles, reports, check-in, and the connections board. Please check with her before changing a setting or adding a page.
notes.testPurpose: A pinned Personal Note on the Rock administrator, the profile many people open first.

notes.author: ted
notes.text: Alisha called from the road. Her dad's follow-up visit in Tucson went well, and the doctor is happy with how he is healing. She will be back in the office Thursday and is answering email in the meantime.
notes.testPurpose: A Phone Note that follows her dad's heart procedure, two weeks after the Pastoral note.

notes.author: jamal
notes.text: More women keep asking to join Alisha's Wednesday group than her living room can hold. Two women in the group are ready to co-lead a second one. Meeting with the three of them next week to plan it.
notes.testPurpose: A Personal Note with a reply on a staff member who also leads a women's small group.

replies.author: pete
replies.text: Love this. Let me know what the new group needs to get started.

notes.author: pete
notes.text: Alisha is carrying the connections board and Rock training on top of the front office. Talk with Greg about moving the weekly bulletin to Daniel's team before the holiday season.
notes.testPurpose: A private note from her supervisor: only Pete sees it, not Alisha when she signs in.

notes.author: pete
notes.text: Alisha is training the campus office volunteers on check-in the same morning as Rock Office Hours. {@daniel} can you host Office Hours that day so she can stay with the training?
notes.testPurpose: A Follow-up note with a mention and a reply, about the Rock Office Hours she leads.

replies.author: daniel
replies.text: Happy to. I'll grab her list of open questions the day before.
